title: Service Designer (Freelance / Part-time)
keywords: people who use and deliver services
profile: Service and UX designer with an MSc in Design Innovation from Maynooth University and 2 years of industry experience. Experienced in qualitative design research, including stakeholder interviews, user interviews, usability testing and thematic analysis, and in synthesizing messy findings into insight and end-to-end service concepts that teams can act on. Designed, prototyped and tested services with real communities in Ireland, from student-run blood-donation drives to Liberties residents in Dublin, working closely with stakeholders and iterating designs based on their feedback.
